objective: Prevent corpus candidates from disappearing between search and review while removing unsupported lifecycle defaults that narrowed the requested object.

evidence: attribution/C8/transition.json: chg-1 predicted fixes observed 0/3 and verdict INEFFECTIVE
changes.failure_pattern: The always-visible lifecycle verb rule imposed operative, closing, or inception gates even when the requested object was a precedent, agreement, or bound policy.
changes.mechanism: Restore C7's neutral separation of eligibility from document and lifecycle attributes, removing categorical verb-to-operation defaults from the base prompt.
changes.rationale: The harmful rule is always visible in the system prompt and directly preceded two shared prompt-level failures; its C8 predictions were unsupported.

changes.failure_pattern: Independent searches surfaced decisive matters and high-signal files, but later regexes or manual shortlists replaced rather than extended the candidate set, allowing leads to vanish without disposition.
changes.mechanism: Require independent filename, content, status, role, and entity search channels to append paths to a monotonic lead union; map every surfaced matter to the candidate register, read or disposition high-signal files, and diff union versus register before drafting and finish. Lifecycle analysis is calibrated to the requested object rather than one verb.
changes.rationale: C8's detailed skill was partially effective and remains the appropriate reusable procedure, but needed auditable discovery state and neutral requested-object calibration rather than another lifecycle heuristic.

debugger/C9/tasks/task-634cc0085ce5291b6045/result.json: final audit checked only the narrowed affirmative set
changes.failure_pattern: The finish interlock accepted corpus completion counts even when no durable lead-union reconciliation artifact existed.
changes.mechanism: For corpus work, deterministically require non-empty lead_union.txt and review_state.md before accepting finish, while retaining the existing capped rejection policy and instructing the agent to diff union matters against register rows.
changes.rationale: Finish is the strongest existing completion control and can verify artifact existence without guessing eligibility or crossing the benchmark boundary.
